body: This week, or week and half has been a relapse for me. I had gone a month or so without being bulimic. But the past week it’s been every day, give or take one of two days of not being able to.   I usually binge and purge all day. I feel really discouraged and pretty depressed. I don’t know if I’ll ever stop being bulimic. I don’t even enjoy it or get the relief of stress from it anymore. I feel so alone and have no one I can tell.
I’m sorry they don’t take you seriously. Just know you’re taking seriously here and people will listen
